property_summary: When a non-depositor account calls setL1BlockValues, the reference reverts while the buggy version does not revert.

When the depositor account calls setL1BlockValues with any values, the reference contract updates the state (e.g., number) while the buggy contract reverts; the test asserts the call succeeds on the reference and fails on the mutant.
When the depositor account (0xDeaDDEaDDeAdDeAdDEAdDEaddeAddEAdDEAd0001) calls setL1BlockValues with arbitrary values, the reference contract's call succeeds, while the buggy mutant's call reverts.

When the depositor account (0xDeaDDEaDDeAdDeAdDEAdDEaddeAddEAdDEAd0001) calls setL1BlockValues, the reference contract succeeds (state variable number unchanged from 0), while the buggy contract always reverts.

When the depositor account (0xDeaDDEaDDeAdDeAdDEAdDEaddeAddEAdDEAd0001) calls setL1BlockValues, the reference contract succeeds (no revert), while the buggy contract reverts; the test asserts success on reference.

When depositor account (0xDeaDDEaDDeAdDeAdDEAdDEaddeAddEAdDEAd0001) calls setL1BlockValues, the reference contract succeeds (no revert) while the buggy contract always reverts; the test asserts that the call succeeds on the reference.
